name: Ravenous
body:
Type curse; Save Will DC 15 negates, Fort DC 15 to avoid effects; Onset 1 hour; Frequency 1/hour

Effect

The target suffers from ravenous hunger. Gorging on a full day’s worth of food satiates the craving until the next failed save. If sufficient food is not available, starvation advances at the rate of 1 day per failed save.
